descZh: 这里原本是联合矿业的一个集结地点，现在已经被无人机占据。现场检测到多架与旗舰实力相当的无人机。
descEn: Originally an ORE staging site, this has been overrun by a Drone infestation. Multiple capital-strength drones have been detected.

descZh: 由天使控制的护盾加强母星。建议使用旗舰突袭这个难以攻破的营地。
descEn: A shielded starbase controlled by the Angel Cartel. It is recommended that this entrenched encampment be assaulted using capital ships.
